rows.requirement: Continuous output rating shall be at least 1200 kVA and 1200 kW at unity power factor, 480 V.
Full rating shall be available at an ambient operating temperature of 40 °C.
Input, bypass, and output electrical configuration shall be 480 V, 3-phase, 3-wire plus ground at 60 Hz.
UPS shall feature a double-conversion online design classified as VFI per IEC 62040-3.
Double-conversion AC-to-AC efficiency shall be at least 96% at 100% load.
Input power factor shall be at least 0.99 and full-load input current distortion (THDi) shall not exceed 5%.
Steady-state output voltage regulation shall be within +/-1% for balanced load changes from 0 to 100%.
Inverter must carry 125 percent of rated load for at least 10 minutes
Provide an automatic static bypass switch within the UPS
Provide a manual maintenance bypass furnished with the UPS
Provide VRLA or lithium-ion batteries sized for not less than 10 minutes runtime at full load
UPS must be capable of parallel operation with at least 3 additional units of the same rating
UPS must be listed to UL 1778
UPS shall be certified for seismic installation per the International Building Code
Each UPS shall fit within a maximum width of 110 inches, depth of 40 inches, and height of 84 inches.
Heat dissipation at full load shall not exceed 150,000 BTU per hour.
